reviews.name: sunil kumar
reviews.text:
Thank you for Amazing Scuba Diving Experience.
I had an incredible scuba diving experience with Dive Adda, and I genuinely recommend them to anyone who wants to explore the underwater world safely and enjoyably.
From the moment we arrived, the team was very professional, friendly, and supportive.
They explained everything clearly — from breathing techniques to hand signals and safety rules — which made me feel confident even as a first-time diver.
The instructors were extremely patient and well-trained. They stayed with me throughout the dive, guided me calmly, and made sure I was comfortable at every moment. The underwater experience was breathtaking — colorful fish, clear water, and a peaceful marine environment that I will never forget.
The staff also captured great photos and videos so I could relive the memories later.

The best part is how simple and hassle-free everything is — just call them, book your slot, pay the advance, and they take care of everything else. You don’t have to worry about anything.

If you are thinking about scuba diving, Dive Adda is the perfect choice. It’s safe, exciting, and handled by truly passionate professionals.
I’m so glad I chose them — it was one of the best experiences of my life!
Highly recommended! 🌊🤿

reviews.name: Madhumita Dhar
reviews.text:
I had an amazing experience at Dive Adda with my instructor Vysakh. I came here to upgrade my certification from a scuba diver to an Open water diver. The entire experience was truly appreciable. Vysakh was very patient and supportive in providing all the skills, no matter how many times I had to repeat it or whenever I panicked all throughout the training and the dive, he always kept his calm. He never seemed irritated, was very professional throughout. All the equipments and gadgets in the centre are so very well maintained, cleaned and taken good care of. Everyone in the centre was very cooperative. Would definitely recommend this centre for others to have an extremely good & memorable underwater experience!
Dive Adda, You Rock!

reviews.name: Sreeram Kumar Thota
reviews.text: Done my pool 🏊 scuba 🤿 on 10 October 2025, due to off season at 🌊 sea. I was forced my self to do pool scuba.  First I thought 💭, it is waste of money 💵.  But Diva Adda guys made it wonderful, we were allotted 2 instructors and both are from Kerala.  Amazing and lovely guys, clarifed our every doubt with a smiley face 😀.  Now I suggest all to do pool scuba before Sea Dive.
